manufacturer_units.evidence_class: Manufacturer type declaration, not identification of the recording producer build.

manufacturer_transfer.fact: This pinned generic driver copies SDK gyro and acceleration fields directly to sensor_msgs/Imu.
manufacturer_transfer.custom_time_fact: The driver labels packet_offset_time in ns, computes it from timestamp minus timebase, and writes header.stamp through double seconds.
manufacturer_transfer.limitation: The recording caller ID is a replay process. Its producer/converter build and any applied calibration are unidentified; current generic code does not identify them.

transform_convention.author_archive_comment: T_lidar_imu maps IMU coordinates into LiDAR coordinates; stored poses use translation then xyzw quaternion.
transform_convention.cloudanalyzer_parameter: imu_from_lidar maps in the opposite direction; an author nonidentity T_lidar_imu would require inversion. Identity is unchanged by inversion.
transform_convention.limitation: Configuration direction/order is not an archive-specific declaration of the reference pose convention.

reference_facts.author: https://staff.aist.go.jp/k.koide/projects/glimsupp/flatwall.html
reference_facts.supported: The author describes LiDAR ground truth from a rigid camera observing tags. The paper describes batch tag/IMU camera trajectories, PTP synchronization and calibrated LiDAR-camera alignment.
reference_facts.unresolved: The selected reference text column/pose direction/body convention and numerical reference-to-LiDAR clock mapping are not established by the inspected sources.

interpretation: Record author-configured values separately from physically verified calibration. Do not fit a transform or offset to reference errors, revise prior results, change defaults or claim accuracy/performance from this input audit.
